request.initial_prompt: And surely, the miser individually will be an ignoble competitor in a State for any prize of victory, or other object of honourable ambition; he will not spend his money in the contest for glory; so afraid is he of awakening his expensive appetites and inviting them to help and join in the struggle; in true oligarchical fashion he fights with a small part only of his resources, and the result commonly is that he loses the prize and saves his money.

raw_segments.text: And surely, the miser individually will be an ignoble competitor in a State for any prize
of victory, or other object of honourable ambition.
He will not spend his money in the contest for glory, so afraid is he of awakening his
expensive appetites and inviting them to help and join in the struggle.
In true oligarchical fashion he fights with a small part only of his resources, and the
result commonly is that he loses the prize and saves his money.
